recomp.needsFiles: its recompilation needs its game files (pick them on its Recompilation page)
recomp.chooseExe: choose the program that starts its recompilation on its Recompilation page
recomp.saveConflict: its saves changed here and in the Emulation folder: pick which to keep on its Recompilation page

trimWait.romDownloading: a ROM is downloading from another PC
trimWait.upgradeRunning: an upgrade is changing a game's files

autoCompressWait.convertRunning: a Convert run is under way
autoCompressWait.installTracked: its install is still under way
autoCompressWait.steamWriting: Steam is downloading or updating it

autoCompressRunning: PlayOut is compressing this game automatically (Settings › Convert › Compress games automatically). Wait for it to finish, or stop it in the game's Upgrade menu.

ra.keyRejected: RetroAchievements rejected the Web API key.
ra.credentialsRejected: RetroAchievements rejected the username or Web API key

updates.nonePublished: No updates have been published yet.
updates.installedOnly: Updates work in installed builds of PlayOut.

combo.single: A single button other than Home is used by games: hold two or more buttons together.

steamGuide.closingOff: Closing Steam to turn off its Guide button and in-game overlay settings…
steamGuide.closingRestore: Closing Steam to put its Guide button setting back…
steamGuide.waiting: Waiting until no game is running: Steam restarts to change the setting.
steamGuide.slowRestart: Steam was slow to close after the last change and is not running again yet, so nothing was changed.
steamGuide.noFiles: Steam's settings files were not found.
steamGuide.slowClose: Steam was slow to close (still running after {seconds} seconds), so its setting was not changed. It will be started again once it has closed.

winhanced.home: Winhanced also uses the Home button, so both react to it: turn off its Guide button setting in Winhanced, or choose other buttons here.
winhanced.viewMenuOverlay: Winhanced opens its overlay with View + Menu, so both react to these buttons: turn that shortcut off in Winhanced, or choose other buttons here.
winhanced.viewMenuGameBar: Winhanced opens Game Bar with View + Menu, so both react to these buttons: turn that shortcut off in Winhanced, or choose other buttons here.

memory.noWindowsAnswer: Windows did not answer the memory cleanup

edits.unknownGame: This game cannot be edited: PlayOut cannot tell which game it is
edits.releaseDate: Enter the release date as YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM or YYYY (month 01-12, day 01-31)

scan.xboxPackages: Could not list the installed Xbox packages
